_doc: The FlatBars editor token vocabulary — ADR-017's single source of truth, the
ONE contract shared by the three consumers it names: the engine `tokenize`
API (whose `kind` strings are the keys below), the `flatbars-lsp` semantic-
token legend (built from the `lsp` mappings), and the TextMate fallback
grammar (`editors/flatbars.tmLanguage.json`).
The fallback grammar is a THIN FLOOR modeled on ERB's tmGrammar shape, split
by SEMANTIC ROLE of every emitted span:
ESCAPE TOKEN — `punctuation.section.embedded.{begin,end}.handlebars`.
The SIGIL-WITH-IDENTIFIER inside control tags is captured SEPARATELY and
carries `keyword.control.*.handlebars` (section / inheritance / import) or
`keyword.directive.handlebars` (set-delim's matched `=` pair).
Every tag region carries `meta.embedded.{line,block}.handlebars`. Inner content
(identifiers, paths, args after the sigil) is default-coloured at the floor.
The LSP is the authority — it emits semantic tokens as CORRECTIONS over the
floor for everything the stateless grammar can't classify dialect-aware:
keywords (`{{else}}`/`{{elif}}`), in-tag literals (string, number), operators
(MaxBars), the set-delimiter directive runs that follow it, and dialect errors.
Three drift gates keep the contract from rotting:
• `check:tmgrammar` — the grammar agrees with the engine on TAG BOUNDARIES
(which characters are inside a FlatBars tag) for every dialect.
• `check:vocab` — every `tmScopes` entry below exists in the grammar; every
kind with empty `tmScopes` is in `lspEmitKinds` (uncolourable otherwise).
• `check:highlight` — pins what the engine's own highlighter emits.
`role`: `tag` (a whole-tag span) or `interior` (a literal/operator carved
inside a tag). `lsp.type`/`lsp.modifiers` are the semantic-token legend entry.
`tmScopes` are the grammar scopes a theme can target; `[]` means the floor
is silent and the LSP fills in.
`lspEmitKinds` is the sparse set the LSP emits over the floor.
`operationPosition` on each tag-role kind drives the LSP helper-name painter (`paintOperations` in `editors/lsp/src/tokens.mjs`). Values:
* `head` — the tag's first identifier paints as `operation` when the operations catalogue knows it (so `{{lookup x y}}` lights up `lookup`, plain `{{name}}` stays default-coloured).
* `always-head` — the tag's first identifier always paints; used for `{{> partial}}` where partial names are user-defined and never in the catalogue.

* `any` — head identifier handled by the TextMate grammar as `keyword.control.*`, but subexpression heads (`(helper arg)`) and pipe targets (`x | helper`) inside the body still scan and paint when known.
* `none` — never paint (comments, raw-block bodies, set-delim, errors, `{{else}}`/`{{elif}}` keywords — handled elsewhere).

expr.description: {{name}} — an interpolation (escaped output). No internal sigil.

raw.description: {{{x}}} / {{&x}} — unescaped (raw) output. For {{&x}} the `&` sigil is split out as `keyword.operator.raw`.

block-open.description: {{#x}} — a section open. Braces are escape tokens; `#x` is the control keyword.

block-parent.description: {{<x}} — an inheritance parent open. The `<` sigil alone is the control keyword.

block-decl.description: {{$x}} — an inheritance block declaration open. The `$` sigil alone is the control keyword.

partial.description: {{> name}} — a partial include. The `>` (or `>*`) sigil alone is the control keyword.

keyword.description: {{else}} / {{elif …}} — a clause separator (dialect-dependent). LSP-emitted: the thin-floor grammar matches it as a generic interpolation.

comment.description: {{! … }} / {{!-- … --}} — a comment. The body is `comment.block.*`; the braces are `punctuation.section.embedded.*` (escape-into-comment).

set-delimiter.description: {{=A B=}} — a set-delimiter directive. The matched `=` pair is the directive keyword. The stateless fallback cannot track the new delimiters that follow (the LSP does).

error.description: A structurally-valid tag the dialect disallows. DIALECT-DEPENDENT: the stateless fallback paints the shape as valid; only the LSP knows the dialect.

string.description: A quoted string literal inside a tag. LSP-emitted: the thin-floor grammar leaves the in-tag body uncoloured.

number.description: A numeric literal inside a tag. LSP-emitted.

operator.description: An infix/prefix operator inside a tag (MaxBars). LSP-emitted: dialect-scoped.

operation.description: A helper / operation name in operation position: the first identifier of a value/raw tag, the identifier of a {{> partial}}, or the identifier immediately after `(` in a subexpression. LSP-emitted: only when the identifier resolves in the operations catalog (operations.json) — so `{{name}}` where `name` is a plain variable stays default-coloured. Partial names always paint (user-defined). Control-tag sigils ({{#each}}, {{/if}}, …) are not re-painted here; the TextMate grammar already covers them as `keyword.control.section`.
